publicContext: Declared frame namespace {namespace}; dimension {dimension}; {unit}. Axis order is declared by the frame.
publicTransformContext: Affine transform from declared frame namespace {sourceNamespace} to declared frame namespace {namespace}; dimension {dimension}; {unit}. Matrix rows follow target axes and columns follow source axes.
publicAxisPage: Declared axes {first} to {last} of {total}, in stored order:
publicTargetTransformContext: Affine transform to declared frame namespace {namespace}; dimension {dimension}; {unit}. Matrix rows follow target axes and columns follow the declared source axes.
title: Coordinate frame
axisHelp: Axis order is explicit. Editing, moving or removing an axis creates a new frame revision. Earlier values keep their pinned frame revision.
frameHelp: Declare the coordinate axes and their common difference unit. Use a positive scale and zero offset. Axis names do not imply a physical, geographic or reference system.
busy: Reading or saving the pinned frame declaration. Your current entries are retained.
historical: This view preserves an earlier revision. Sources and axes remain readable; open the current declaration to amend it.
transformHelp: Declare y = A x + b. Matrix rows follow the target frame axes and columns follow the source frame axes. Translation is a vector in the pinned target frame. The square matrix must be nonsingular; no inverse, rotation or physical meaning is inferred.
chooseFrames: Choose the source and target frame declarations first.
completeTransform: Choose both frames, the matrix and the translation vector. Your draft is retained.
invalidCell: Choose a present, non-excluded native matrix or vector of the declared dimension. The saved transform validates component values, units and frame revisions.
frameAssignmentHelp: Choose the exact frame revision for this vector. Match its length, declared namespace and explicit unit before saving the schema. Assigning a frame does not convert the retained values.
frameResultFixed: This result keeps the frame and affine transform that produced it. Renaming the column preserves its coordinate declaration.
invalidFrame: Choose a complete saved coordinate frame with an explicit axis order and difference unit.
waitFrame: Wait for the selected frame declaration to finish loading. Your schema entries are retained.
graphHelp: The source vector must name the transform’s exact source frame revision. Matrix rows follow target axes; columns follow source axes. The result retains the target frame and transform revision.
graphOperandRequired: Choose an earlier native vector with an explicitly assigned coordinate frame.
graphModelRequired: Choose a saved affine coordinate transform.
graphUpgradeHelp: This creates a graph revision with explicit pinned coordinate frames and affine transforms. Existing graph revisions and retained results remain available.
graphVersionRequired: Enable declared coordinate transforms in this saved graph before adding this operation.
graphModelInvalid: Choose a saved affine coordinate transform with pinned frame, matrix and translation sources.
lineageTransform: Affine coordinate transform with pinned source and target frames. Inspect the retained source vector, matrix, translation and frame declarations below.
lineageComponent: Declared frame axis {axis}, in its pinned stored order.
